ordered_operations: discard a card as the activation cost
put the discard trigger on the stack at the next checkpoint
resolve damage to all active opponents
resolve the original Glint-Horn draw ability
preconditions: Glint-Horn damages all three active opponents in one resolving trigger.
required_assertions: trigger context identifies P1, P2, and P3
no undamaged player contributes a Treasure
Treasure creation precedes the original loot draw

plain_english: Glint-Horn is attacking when its loot ability is activated, and discarding the card as a cost triggers its damage ability.
At the next rules checkpoint the damage trigger is put above the original draw ability and resolves first, damaging all three opponents.
Malcolm records that exact opponent set, creates exactly three Treasures, and the original Glint-Horn ability draws afterward.
title: Malcolm creates one Treasure for each actually damaged opponent before the loot draw resolves
